//: The workers, typechecked. The root tsconfig excludes `workers/`, so until 8 Sep nothing typechecked them at all — an edit to workers/pipeline could break the build and `tsc --noEmit` stayed green, which is exactly how a wrong column or a missing import reaches production. `wrangler deploy` transpiles with esbuild and does not typecheck either.
//exclude: workers/ffmpeg is left out: it imports @cloudflare/containers, which is installed in its own package rather than at the root, and it shares no code with src/. The two that matter here are pipeline and process-upload — they import from src/lib/, and that coupling is what breaks silently when a library moves.
